EndToEndTransformationDescription . maxErrorStateInvalid 0 No errors allowed EndToEndTransformationDescription . upperHeaderBitsToShift 64 64 bits from Some/IP header to be shifted BufferProperties . headerLength 160 160 bits is the length of E2E profile 7 header.
